title: 19. Stop! That's Dangerous!
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: Hori couldn't stop thinking about the superhero movie he'd watched last night. Flying through the sky and defeating villains looked so cool! I want to fly like that, too! He tied a cloth around his neck to make a cape.
Bori was drawing nearby. Hori wanted to look even cooler in front of Bori. He struggled up onto a desk and stood tall. Bori, look! Super Hori can fly through the sky! Bori looked up anxiously.
Super Hori, to the rescue! Hori jumped off the desk. But he couldn't really fly. For a moment, his body rose through the air, then fell straight down with a thump.
Ouch! Hori fell to the floor and held his leg. His knee throbbed, and tears filled his eyes. The wonderful Super Hori was gone. All that remained was a sore leg.
Teacher Sheep hurried over in alarm. That really hurt, didn't it? You're okay now. The teacher gently cleaned Hori's knee and put on a bandage. Hori sniffled and nodded.
With his bandage on, Hori thought carefully. I tried to look cool, but only got hurt. Jumping from high places really is dangerous. As he limped along, Hori remembered that lesson.
A few days later, Hori's leg was better, and he returned happily to the Rainbow Class. A little mark from the bandage reminded him of that day. I won't do dangerous things anymore!

Then Toto ran around holding scissors. That's dangerous! Hori quickly stood in the way. Stop, Toto! If you run with scissors, you could fall and get hurt! Hori's tail stripes sparkled like a rainbow, and Toto stopped.

Soon afterward, Kongi climbed onto a desk and was about to jump, just as Hori had done. Stop, Kongi! You could get hurt like I did! Hori gently took Kongi's hand and helped them down. Startled, Kongi climbed down quietly.

The friends hugged Hori. Thanks to you, we didn't get hurt! Thank you! Teacher Sheep smiled proudly. Hori, you've become a wonderful safety helper. Let's keep ourselves and our friends away from danger. We are safer when we look after each other.
